references.note: third-party BGA wiki card page; re-checked 2026-11-24 (page rev. 2024/10/10). Confirmed: cost none (コスト: ー), prerequisite 1 occupation (条件: 職業1), points none (勝利点: ー), effect = 'このカードは畑である。このカードから最後の小麦か最後の野菜を取り除くたび、すぐにそれぞれ野菜か小麦をこのカードにまくことができる。' (this card is a field; when the last grain or vegetable is removed, immediately sow the opposite type). JA 寸評 notes removal is not limited to harvest (e.g. rotary-plow pull-out).

English list page row re-checked 2026-11-24 (list rev. 2026/06/12). Confirmed effect text: 'This card is a field. Each time you remove the last grain or vegetable from this card, you can immediately sow vegetable or grain on this card, respectively.' List row carries no cost/prereq/points columns.

effects.notes: This card is a field on your board (card-as-field modeling not in the vocabulary).
Whenever the last grain or vegetable is removed from this card, you may immediately sow the opposite type (vegetable or grain) on this card.

unresolved_fields: effects: card-as-field modeling ('this card is a field') is not covered by the effect vocabulary; whether/how a minor improvement acts as a farmyard field is an engine-design question, not decidable from literature (BQ-7 / R-C1). Re-checked 2026-11-24: JA p=2683 + EN list both confirm 'このカードは畑である / This card is a field'.

effects.1.trigger: source text confirms removal — not harvest — is the trigger ('最後の小麦か最後の野菜を取り除くたび / each time you remove the last grain or vegetable'; JA 寸評: 収穫に限定されてない). Remaining open question is the trigger point/granularity of the auto-resow in the engine (BQ-7).
review.notes: Cost: none (JA/EN co-confirmed; EN list row has no cost field). Prerequisite: 1 occupation (JA table: 条件=職業1). Printed points: none/0 (JA table: 勝利点=ー). Effect: this card is a field; whenever the last grain or last vegetable is removed from it, immediately sow the opposite type (vegetable or grain) on it — not harvest-limited per JA commentary. Sources: JA p=2683 (rev. 2024/10/10), EN cardlist_en/ (rev. 2026/06/12), both re-checked 2026-11-24. Third-party BGA wiki cross-check only; not official Lookout verification. Remaining gaps are engine modeling of card-as-field and of removal-trigger granularity — see unresolved_fields. status stays needs_resolution.
